title: Orbit product hero
intentLine: A machined-metal product body on a low plinth, slow orbital presentation, key+rim lighting, accent signal light.

title: Particle constellation hero
intentLine: A deep starfield of instanced points with depth falloff and an accent core, slow drift, additive glow discipline.

title: Glass prism refraction
intentLine: A dispersive glass prism over a dark scene: iridescence, back rim light, emissive core — never flat glassmorphism.

title: Kinetic 3D type headline
intentLine: A hero headline as dimensional type with staggered kinetic entrance and weighted settle; MSDF text only.

title: Pedestal material study
intentLine: A cinematic-floor pedestal with a torus-knot material study: brushed metal PBR, contact shadow, imperfection pass.

title: Loop column gallery
intentLine: A vertical loop column of distinct image plates cycling with weighted motion; plates read as photographs, not voids.

title: Filmstrip 3D carousel
intentLine: An angled 3D filmstrip of image cards with perspective recession and one focused card; distinct plates, no echo.

title: Orrery mechanism
intentLine: A machined gear mechanism with metallic PBR, slow meshing rotation, and a jewel accent pivot.

title: Editorial oversized type
intentLine: A massive editorial headline with tight tracking discipline, a kicker line, and an accent underline rule.

title: Bento metrics grid
intentLine: A 2x2 bento of stat tiles with one dominant cell; machined surfaces, engineered gradients, no flat voids.

title: Gradient CTA object
intentLine: A primary CTA as a physical object: engineered gradient ramp, press-down state, accent edge light (DL12).

title: Photo hero composite
intentLine: A layered photographic hero plate with filmic grade, foreground subject separation, and caption block.

title: Brand mark wall
intentLine: A 3x2 wall of monochrome brand-mark tiles rendered premium on machined tiles — no icon-pack styling.

title: Premium pricing card
intentLine: A single flagship pricing card: tier name, price figure, feature list rhythm, one accent CTA row.

title: Testimonial panel
intentLine: A typographic client quote with oversized quotation mark, attribution line, and surface depth.

title: Feature triptych
intentLine: Three feature cards in rhythm with icon seats, title/body hierarchy, and hover lift states.

title: Data ticker ribbon
intentLine: A horizontal data ribbon of mono figures scrolling with constant velocity and edge fades.

title: Navigation dock
intentLine: A floating navigation dock of five entries with active state, machined rail, and press-down affordance.

title: Rich empty state
intentLine: An empty-state panel that is rich, never void (DL16): guidance copy, ghost preview, one accent action.

title: Footer colophon
intentLine: A footer colophon with type-scale discipline: wordmark, three link columns, legal line, hairline rules.
